newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-DUTCH FACE ROMANIA WITHOUT KRAJICEK.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DUTCH FACE ROMANIA WITHOUT KRAJICEK.

text.p: The Netherlands will be without Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek for their Davis Cup World Group first round tie against Romania in Bucharest next week.

Krajicek is still recovering from a knee operation and Dutch coach Stanley Franker on Thursday named Jan Siemerink, ranked 21st in the world, and Sjeng Schalken, ranked 88th, as his likely singles players.
Former world doubles champions Jacco Eltingh and Paul Haarhuis, who reached the semifinals in last week's Australian Open in Melbourne, will play the doubles.
The Dutch lost 3-2 to India in the first round last year.
